title: R' Zavdi son of Rabbi Yaakov bar Zavdi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 3, halakhah 5, speaking in Rabbi Yonah’s name; there, at chapter 1, halakhah 2, folio 7b, the reading is “son of Rabbi Yaakov bar Zavdiya.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital texts of Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:5 and 1:2 both name Zavdiya son of Yaakov bar Zavdi. Hyman’s heading gives Zavdi and his second occurrence has the terminal Zavdiya; these source forms and their order are retained.

The whole Guggenheimer Berakhot 3:5 and 1:2 paragraphs fully name Rabbi Zavdiya son of Rabbi Yaakov bar untitled Zavdi, reporting Rabbi Yonah. Hyman’s exact Zavdi heading and his terminal Zavdiya occurrence remain as supplied. Rabbi Yaakov and Rabbi Yonah have local full-title support; the differing Zavdi heading uses R' without transferring the title from Zavdiya. The historical folio remains unchanged and no fathers are merged.
